label: caiso 14 solar shape
definition: Adds --caiso-import-solar-shape on top of gas-coupled imports: collapses the marginal long-neighbor import blocks (DSW_solar/Palo Verde, PNW_midC/Mid-C) and the export sinks toward the REC/PTC -$20 floor as CAISO net load drops into its spring-midday belly, restoring the negative midday tail. Negative hours ~14 -> 407 vs actual DA 755 (92% precision against held-out hourly LMP); <=$5 922 vs 923; load-weighted mean 46 -> 42 (actual 35.8); price body (p50/p95) preserved. Caveat: in-sample band (HI/LO=30/10 net-load pct, anchored to ~9% neg prevalence); 2025 OOS confounded by a pre-existing high body; recall 50% (shallow-negative hours sit at $0-5).
